At Marion Light Rail Lift between Marion St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
 
For your safety, do not use if the doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs, if able to
  • Or use alternative light rail stops (Taverners Hill or Hawthorne or Taverners Hill), due to no alternative lift available at this stop
For urgent assistance:

  • Or call 131 500
